measurement.name: knowledge_items_unindexed
measurement.reported_by: embed_arcs stats JSON and brain-feed/knowledge-scope-report.json; None when a run skipped on the lock

interfaces.brain-knowledge producer: one row per lesson log entry and per decision file; key lesson:<marker_id>, lesson:<log stem>:<content revision> for entries without a marker id, decision:<marker_id or ADR id>
interfaces.POST /search: optional project_id (exact containment on metadata projects, GIN index idx_ce_projects) and brain (exact match)
interfaces.POST /metadata: {key, producer, metadata} replaces that producer's metadata for the key without re-embedding; 404 when absent; 422 without producer
interfaces.embed_arcs: runs the knowledge stage in the same run; state .brain-knowledge-embed.state.json, lock .brain-knowledge-embed.lock
interfaces.scope report: brain-feed/knowledge-scope-report.json lists unattributed items with key, kind, path and entry ts, plus scanned, unindexed, read error and duplicate key counts

rollback.action: the brain-lesson whole-log producer and every existing producer are unchanged, so the last accepted index stays active; the indexer never writes the vault except its state, lock and report; removing the knowledge stage leaves brain-knowledge rows that one prune or delete by producer clears
rollback.rehearsal: test_a_failed_reindex_keeps_the_active_items_and_resumes_once and test_a_failed_write_never_prunes_the_knowledge_producer show earlier rows survive a failed run; the unchanged brain-lesson assertions in test_tick_cycle show the old index still serves (unit level and CI end to end, mocked vault content)

limitations: flock gives exclusion on one host and across hosts only where the NFS vault mount honours it
a lesson entry without a marker id gets a new key when edited; its old row stays searchable until the next --prune run, which compose and the chart pass
the disclosure check covers the /metadata 404 body; /search error bodies are not asserted
MCP and feed callers do not pass project_id or brain yet; that wiring belongs to later SV2-BRP packages
the brain-lesson whole-log rows remain as the rollback path and still appear in unfiltered searches
no metrics sink exists in the kernel; the measurement is a stats field and the report file
